sources.label: ECI assembly/parliamentary constituency boundaries via DataMeet (datameet/maps)
sources.notes: Election Commission of India delimitation geometry redistributed by DataMeet. Backs acs.geojson (70 ACs, 2008 delimitation) and pcs.geojson (7 PCs; PC file URL recorded as https://raw.githubusercontent.com/datameet/maps/master/parliamentary-constituencies/india_pc_2019_simplified.geojson in the same record). Also feeds the derived jurisdiction_crosswalk.json. License recorded as 'DataMeet community data'.

sources.label: Delhi municipal wards (pre-2022 interim) via DataMeet (datameet/Municipal_Spatial_Data)
sources.notes: Backs wards.geojson (~290 pre-2022 charges incl. NDMC + Cantonment; predates the 2022 unified-MCD 250-ward delimitation — shipped as labelled interim per CREDITS.md caveat). Ward geometry also underlies ward_heat.geojson, ward_heat_summary.json, ward_aqi.geojson, jurisdiction_crosswalk.json, and the ward attribution inside shelters.geojson. License CC BY-SA 2.5 IN.

sources.label: Villages Maps of Delhi (OpenCity, Government of Delhi KML, 2022)
sources.notes: Backs villages.geojson (district-tagged village polygons, 2022) and districts.geojson (11 districts dissolved from the village polygons per scripts/recipes/delhi/build_opencity_layers.py). Per-resource download URLs and checksums are in data/cities/delhi/source/opencity/_raw/_manifest.json.

sources.label: Delhi Water Bodies Census Data (OpenCity, 2023 KML)
sources.notes: Backs water.geojson (893 water-body points, 2023), converted from KML by build_opencity_layers.py.

sources.label: Delhi Hourly Air Quality Reports (CPCB/DPCC/IMD CAAQMS data via OpenCity)
sources.notes: Publisher recorded as central-pollution-control-board; per-station CSVs 2017-2023 (DPCC/IMD monitors). Backs air_quality.geojson and ward_aqi.geojson (built by scripts/recipes/delhi/build_air_quality.py from _raw/delhi-hourly-air-quality-reports/).

sources.label: CAAQMS monitoring-station coordinates (station_master.csv, source tag 'cpcb_caaqms')
sources.notes: Station lat/lon and operating agency (DPCC/IMD etc.) for the air_quality.geojson / ward_aqi.geojson station points. The on-disk record tags each row source=cpcb_caaqms but records no URL for the CPCB portal itself — honest blank; the build script header confirms coordinates come from this curated master, not Google Maps.

sources.label: Open Transit Data Delhi — static GTFS bundle (GNCTD)
sources.notes: Public no-key static GTFS download (OTD_STATIC_URL in the delhi-acquire adapter). Backs bus_routes.geojson (route LineStrings from shapes.txt / longest-trip reconstruction per scripts/recipes/delhi/acquire_gtfs.py).

sources.label: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API (amenity/transit/road queries)
sources.notes: Overpass queries defined in sevent4/domain/delhi_acquire.py back stops.geojson (highway=bus_stop), metro.geojson (subway stations), metro_lines.geojson, rrts.geojson (Namo Bharat), rail.geojson, roads.geojson (motorway/trunk/primary 'Major roads'), health.geojson, schools.geojson, police.geojson, fire.geojson, toilets.geojson. OSM is reference-tier in this atlas, ODbL 1.0.

sources.label: New Delhi OSM shapefile extract (BBBike, OpenStreetMap contributors)
sources.notes: 2026-01-09 snapshot, ODbL 1.0. Only the waterways layer was ingested — backs drains.geojson (975 drainage/canal/river segments clipped to the NCT ward union); roads/rail/points/buildings explicitly NOT ingested (recorded as redundant/rejected in the same sources.json).

sources.label: Delhi Public Library zone pages (branch locations register)
sources.notes: DPL-published branch/sub-branch locations parsed from dpl.gov.in zone pages (source_url column per row), geocoded with confidence flags. Backs dpl_libraries.geojson.

sources.label: Delhi Public Library annual reports (dpl.gov.in)
sources.notes: Per-year report PDFs with sha256 in the fetch manifest (e.g. https://dpl.gov.in/images/annualreport910.pdf). Backs the DPL metrics time series (dpl_annual_metrics.csv, dpl_ten_year_time_series.csv) used by the library analysis behind dpl_libraries.geojson attributes — not a separate map layer. The archive manifest records that a later re-fetch of dpl.gov.in failed (connection timeouts) and that 2012-13 was obtained via a Google Drive mirror URL recorded therein (data/cities/delhi/source/libraries/dpl_annual_report_archive_manifest.csv).

sources.label: DUSIB (Delhi Urban Shelter Improvement Board) district-wise night shelters / live occupancy report
sources.notes: Backs shelters.geojson. Provenance is embedded per-feature ('source' field: DUSIB District wise Night Shelters List, live occupancy report, fetched 2026-07-01 11:03 IST), with per-feature geocode_confidence and ward-vintage caveat notes.

sources.label: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC — USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 (Landsat 8/9) land surface temperature
sources.notes: Heat layers are a derivation, not a downloaded dataset: the adapter queries collection 'landsat-c2-l2' filtered to platforms landsat-8/landsat-9 and computes a QA-masked LST median. Backs ward_heat.geojson, ward_heat_summary.json (window 2024-04-01/2026-07-01 recorded in the file), heat30m.png and heat30m_bounds.json. Quarterly refresh via .github/workflows/heat-refresh.yml.

sources.label: GNCTD Finance Department budget portal (finance.delhi.gov.in)
sources.notes: Manifest indexes Budget at a Glance 2007-08..2026-27, Budget Speeches, Receipts Budgets, Gender Budgets and Detailed Demands for Grants with per-document URLs (most status 'discovered', not yet fetched). Backs the Delhi finance work under data/cities/delhi/source/budget/ — no public map layer in public/cities/delhi/layers/ yet.

sources.label: Municipal Corporation of Delhi budget documents (mcdonline.nic.in)
sources.notes: MCD seed URLs plus 22 discovered budget PDFs (e.g. mcdonline.nic.in/portal/downloadFile/expenditure_rbe__12-13_south_mcd_*.pdf). Backs municipal-finance claims; no public map layer yet.

sources.label: New Delhi Municipal Council budgets and NDMC Act 1994 (ndmc.gov.in)
sources.notes: Vision-verified NDMC Budget at a Glance 2026-27 and 2025-26, Budget Speech, Vol 1, plus the NDMC Act 1994 page grounding the no-elected-council governance note; local PDFs under budget/ndmc/pdfs/. Backs finance/governance claims (also context for governance.json); no public map layer.

sources.label: Centre for Policy Research SPCB study working papers (Delhi PCC staffing and finances)
sources.notes: CPR 'Who is in the field?' (2022-10) and 'Are they in the green?' (2023-04, URL also recorded in the same file) — DPCC sanctioned posts 184→343, consents 3,224→11,698. Backs the pollution regulator-capacity material (data/cities/delhi/source/pollution/capacity.json); no public map layer in the Delhi layers dir.

sources.label: DPCC primary records: post-creation order 2019, RTI replies on vacancies (2021) and finance (2022)
sources.notes: Primary DPCC records held locally under data/cities/delhi/source/pollution/raw/ (Office_order_28.06.2019.pdf; RTI 60075 — 218 of 343 posts vacant as of 1 Aug 2021; RTI 60047 finance FY18-21, OCR too poor for line items). The recorded web URL is the DPCC official site marked 'to_acquire'. Backs regulator-capacity claims; no public map layer.

sources.label: Census of India 2011 — NCT population denominators
sources.notes: NCT of Delhi 2011 population 16,787,941, held audit-only per the row's own note (not the current DPL denominator). Backs population denominators in the library-access analysis behind dpl_libraries.geojson-adjacent metrics.

sources.label: Census of India 2011 Houselisting (HLPCA) Table H-14 — household vehicle ownership, New Delhi district
sources.notes: Raw file on disk at data/cities/delhi/source/vehicle_ownership_census/HLPCA-07094-NewDelhi-2011_H14.xlsx plus a ward sample CSV; the source directory itself records no URL — the verbatim NADA catalog download URL is documented in the mobility scoping note. Backs vehicle-ownership claims; no public map layer yet.
